text_block_list.text:
—I had a dream.
One I've held since childhood.
To become a Trainer who raises the "strongest"
horsegirl of all.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki takes the inside lane!
Fuji Kiseki slips through!
A burst of yellow silks is flying in from
the outside! Fuji Kiseki takes the lead!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
A magnificent finish at 1 minute 34.7
seconds!
Fuji Kiseki is poised to rule next year's
Classics!

I had an older brother whom I deeply admired.
As Fuji Kiseki's
attending doctor,
he worked tirelessly to support her physical
maintenance and conditioning.

text_block_list.name: Brother
text_block_list.text:
She's amazing, isn't she?
She has the caliber to stand atop her
generation.
I know she can take the Derby...!
I've got to give her everything I have,
too.

text_block_list.name: Brother
text_block_list.text:
Do your best on the Trainer Exam, too. Someday,
it'd be incredible
if we could help your horsegirl win the
Derby together.
But—
choice_data_list: Brother! Is Fuji Kiseki really inj...

text_block_list.name: Brother
text_block_list.text:
...It's my fault.
I failed to prevent her injury.
I ended up robbing Fuji Kiseki of her
future...!

Due to a breakdown,
Fuji Kiseki was forced to retire from the
front lines.
Having devoted everything to her racing career,
the remorse that tormented my brother ran
deep—

I wanted to ease my brother's regrets.
I wanted us to share our dream once more.
That was why I resolved to lead my own
horsegirl to the "strongest" summit—
to conquer the Derby.

With that resolution,
I entered Tracen Academy...
but things hadn't gone well.
Time and again,
horsegirls were put off by my overzealous
passion, leaving me without a trainee.

text_block_list.name: Rude Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text: You pickin' a fight with us, punk?! Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Furious Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
...Hah?
You're the ones who stepped out of line,
assholes.

text_block_list.name: Rude Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
Who d'you think you're talkin' to?!
Actin' all high and mighty just 'cause you're
an "ex"-leader!
You're the one daydreamin' in the middle of
the path!

text_block_list.name: Furious Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Quit your yapping.
If you can't even cough up an apology...
I'll just have to crush you.

text_block_list.name: Rude Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
—Tch! Damn you,
I'll break that haughty nose of yours...!
Hey, you!
Settle this on the track right now!!

It seemed like a spat between horsegirls.
Though it looked like they were going to
settle it with a race, would they really—

text_block_list.name: Furious Horsegirl
text_block_list.text: Ora ora ora oraaah!!

text_block_list.name: Furious Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Here we go, here we go, here we gooo!!
I'm gonna blow right past youuuu—!!

text_block_list.name: Rude Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Wha...!
I was sure I left her in the dust,
but she's already...?!

text_block_list.name: Furious Horsegirl
text_block_list.text: —Haha! Not even close...!!

—Breathtaking. A vivid,
fierce stride that instantly gripped the
hearts of onlookers.
It was just like the run I witnessed that
day...

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
On the inside,
along the rail! Fuji Kiseki!
Fuji Kiseki surges through the absolute
inside!

Compared to Fuji Kiseki,
her style was far more wild and unrefined.
And yet...

Boundless raw potential.
The caliber fit for the "strongest." The
sheer thrill and anticipation.
All of it overlapped with the Fuji Kiseki
I saw that day—

text_block_list.name: Furious Horsegirl
text_block_list.text: WOOOORAAAHHHHHHHHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Rude Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
...Th-This is the "Howling Demon"...
The former leader of "L/Roars"...!

text_block_list.name: Rude Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Dammit...
This wasn't supposed to happen...!!

text_block_list.name: Furious Horsegirl
text_block_list.text: —Had enough, or do you still wanna play?

text_block_list.name: Furious Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Well, as long as it kills time,
I don't mind taking you on.
Though before that...
you gotta pay what you owe, don'tcha?

I suddenly came back to my senses. Right,
they were in the middle of a fight.
Anxiety surged through my racing chest as
I held my breath,
watching the volatile standoff.
choice_data_list: (If things get violent, I should r...

text_block_list.name: Furious Horsegirl
text_block_list.text: Settle the score. Just like you promised—

text_block_list.name: Furious Horsegirl
text_block_list.text: Pay me back for my triple-scoop ice cream!

text_block_list.name: Rude Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Urgh...!
A free racer never goes back on her
word...
Whether it's three scoops or five,
I'll pay for it...!

text_block_list.name: Furious Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah! ♪
Can I get toppings on that five-scooper,
then?!

text_block_list.name: Furious Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Well look at that,
you're a pretty good sport after all!
That ice cream place over there is crazy good—
you should grab one too!

To think the whole quarrel was over a
triple-scoop ice cream...
While I stood there dumbfounded,
they walked off together.
—The next day.

I was at the Academy,
assisting the instructors with coaching the
horsegirls.
I was lending a hand to gain some practical
coaching experience, but—

—I couldn't get the image of that girl from
yesterday and her running out of my head.
The thrill from that moment still hadn't
cooled down.
She truly had what it took to become the
"strongest"...!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
...Um. Excuse me...
Do you have any feedback on my running just
now?

Snapping back from my wandering thoughts,
I hurriedly turned my attention to the girl
before me.
I have to give this training my all!

This girl has great speed aptitude.
If we drill hard on the slope course
to sharpen her explosive power while building
shredded muscle—!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text: Huh? A b-booster...?
choice_data_list: Yeah! It's like the ultimate speci...

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Ah... right... Well, thanks anyway.
See ya. —Instructooor!
...I did it again.

Whenever I get carried away,
I end up using such childish
expressions...
I knew it only put people off,
yet I couldn't seem to break the habit.
Hah? The hell's childish about it?

Being the "strongest" sounds badass to me.
I happen to like that kinda talk, y'know?
